topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I don't know how much more of this I can handle. The walls feel like they're closing in, every breath a little harder to draw. I found out about Alex today. For months, they've been spinning this elaborate tale about their prestigious job, the one with all the late nights and the important meetings. Turns out, it was all just smoke and mirrors. Now, every conversation we've ever had feels hollow, a shell of something that was never real. I keep thinking, what else have they been hiding? Every smile, every reassurance—it's like none of it mattered. I don't know where to turn, who to trust. The world out there, it just seems so much darker now.
